findings.title: Other subgroup access paths still dereference a concurrently deleted group
findings.body: `modelSupplier.get()` can return null when the cached group is removed concurrently, as the new null check in `getSubGroupsCount()` acknowledges. The three paginated/search `getSubGroupsStream` overloads (starting here and at lines 262 and 268) still immediately dereference that value. A request fetching a group's subgroups can therefore still fail with an NPE/500 when deletion wins the race; these paths need the same deleted-model handling (for example, returning an empty stream or the API's defined not-found behavior).

findings.title: The concurrency test can finish before the reader executes or reports its failure
findings.body: The reader thread is started and discarded without a latch/barrier to prove that it has made a read request, and it is never joined before asserting `caughtExceptions`. Deletion can complete before the new thread is scheduled, or the assertion can run while the final read is still in progress; an NPE occurring afterward will not fail the test. The test should retain the thread/future, synchronize at least one overlapping read with deletion, stop it in a finally block, and wait for it before checking exceptions.
